visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Every press adds a like
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Pressing the heart again should take the like back, but the count keeps going up. The page does not remember that it was already liked.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: 5

solution.code: 5
solution.explanation: A toggle needs to remember its current state. A boolean tells whether the next press adds or removes a like, and each press flips it.

checks.label: A second press takes it back to 5
